usedFor: A cancelled Shopify order updates the pass in the customer's wallet through AddToWallet.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Update Pass” in AddToWallet
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order is a clear moment to change a pass, so it shows nothing stale.

watchOut: “Update Pass” needs a pass already made earlier by “Create Pass” in AddToWallet.
